title: Why Your Brain Won't Let You Tickle Yourself 🧠
description:
Try to tickle yourself right now. Nothing happens, right? Here is the real neuroscience behind why your brain mutes your own touch — and how a robotic arm experiment proved it.

Source: Blakemore, Wolpert & Frith (1998), Nature Neuroscience — "Central cancellation of self-produced tickle sensation."
